shared_elements: border or band of repeated linear pattern along the top/edge
horizontal line dividing the surface into registers
upright slab/pillar as the carrying surface
filled ornamental panel below a figural scene
justification: Both are upright stone monuments whose surface is split by a horizontal line into an upper register containing profile quadrupeds accompanied by a small human-like figure and a lower zone dominated by sinuous, snaking forms, with a repeated-motif band running along the upper edge — a genuinely comparable two-register scheme. The manner of execution differs sharply, however: A is sparse, rounded low relief with isolated naturalistic animals floating on blank ground, while B is a dense, flat, tightly interlaced linear engraving that leaves almost no empty field, so beyond the broad compositional skeleton there is little to connect them.
